documents.title: Amber Valley Council Working-age Council Tax Reduction Scheme (operative 2026/27)
Amber Valley Council — Full Council adoption record for the 2026/27 Council Tax Reduction Scheme (Minute 5257)

identification.carries_amendments: continues the scheme for 2026/27 with Housing-Benefit-style uprating only
identification.chain: "5257 COUNCIL TAX SUPPORT SCHEME 2026/27. The Council considered a report seeking approval for the continuation of the local Council Tax Support Scheme for the financial year 2026/27. RESOLVED: 1 That the following be approved as Amber Valley Borough Council's Local Council Tax Support Scheme from 1 April 2026: a) That working age claimants can continue to receive full help towards their Council Tax if they are on a low income, in the same way as pension age claimants, with no reduction to be applied." (from Full Council minutes, 21 January 2026, pp.5-6)

metadata.adoption_reference: Full Council, 21 January 2026 (Minute No. 5257, item "Council Tax Support Scheme 2026/27")
